title: From the Heel of Italy
description: Updates from Pastor Mirko and Full Gospel Church in Modugno, Southern Italy: family, church life, Il Rifugio Center, missions and church planting across Puglia and beyond.
author: Pastor Mirko

areas.name: Family Life
areas.intro: Personal news from Pastor Mirko and family: what God is doing in our home, how we are doing, and how you can pray for us.

areas.name: Our Church – Modugno
areas.intro: Full Gospel Church in Modugno, near Bari, was born in the 1970s from a Dutch missionary work. Here we share news on events, new projects, initiatives and the vision we are pursuing for our city.

areas.name: Il Rifugio Center
areas.intro: Il Rifugio, in Ruvo di Puglia, is a centre serving churches in Puglia and across Italy: camps, retreats, conferences, leadership training and a place of rest for missionaries.

areas.name: To the Ends of the Earth
areas.intro: Sending workers beyond our borders and preparing young people to go: training, departures and stories from those we send.

areas.name: Plant & Strengthen
areas.intro: Planting new churches across Puglia, a region where many towns still have no living church, and standing alongside existing churches that need support to keep going.
